findings.control: secret management: no hardcoded credentials in source
findings.rationale: A service token is assigned from a string literal in source - any reader of the repository holds the credential, and rotation requires a code change.

findings.control: command execution: no shell invocation with untrusted input
findings.rationale: User-controlled input is interpolated into a shell command string executed via sh -c, so input can append arbitrary shell operators and commands.

findings.control: code execution: no eval of untrusted input
findings.rationale: An untrusted expression is passed to eval - direct arbitrary code execution within the process.

findings.control: file access: path containment for user-named files
findings.rationale: A user-named filename is joined to a base directory with no containment check, so ../ sequences escape the base and read arbitrary files.
